## Positioning
Sahil Verma is a passionate Full Stack Engineer based in Chandigarh, India. He leads small
teams, designs and ships enterprise-grade applications, and cares deeply about sustainable,
scalable systems that actually create impact for the people who use them. He is open to
senior full-stack and technical-lead roles where he can own delivery end to end —
architecture, hands-on engineering and team leadership.

Key numbers:
- 9+ years shipping production software (first role July 2016)
- 10+ engineers led across teams
- 3+ domains: finance, power/energy, enterprise
- 8 professional certifications across AWS, Azure and Infosys

## Projects & case studies (complete)

### Trade Confirmation System (CIAO) — Energy Trading · Fintech (Infosys · 2021 — Present)
Trade confirmation management system for British Petroleum — send, receive and process
inbound documents and contracts. At Infosys, Sahil built the UI from scratch, owned the
React frontend end to end, maintained 80% unit test coverage, and led a 3-member team.
Deployed via Jenkins and ROSA.
- Role: Tech Lead — leading a team of 3
- Stack: ReactJS, TypeScript, SASS, Jest, Kendo UI, Jenkins, ROSA
- Outcomes: enabled BP to send, receive and process inbound contracts; high-confidence releases backed by strong test coverage

### EY VIA — Audit · Risk · Enterprise (Infosys)
Virtual internal auditing platform for Ernst & Young, handling auditing, risk management and
report generation based on various factors and calculations.
- Role: Engineer
- Stack: React JS, JavaScript, NodeJS, PostgreSQL, Jest, SASS
- Outcome: streamlined internal auditing for an enterprise client

### Sustainability Platform — Media · Sustainability (Infosys)
As a Digital Innovation Partner, Infosys powers The Economist Group's global initiative to
advance discourse on sustainability among world leaders and businesses.
